analysis_profile_requirements.requirement: Score timestamped probabilities, event boundaries or detections on a frozen cohort.
Include quiet/active speech, idle noise, known positives/negatives and onset/offset delay strata.
Verify independent state, exact source intervals, availability and cross-hop behavior.
Record dropped/stale events and no stale cross-epoch event revival.
Reject malformed, missing and nonfinite inputs; keep validity separate from nonspeech.
Measure paced target-device timing/resources; separate callback suitability from compute speed.
Record missing, invalid, nonfinite and adverse controls without qualifying the candidate.

asset_requirements.notes: Approved Picovoice Cobra runtime/library for the target platform; no runtime is present.
Explicit approved access-key handling/terms; keys must never be committed or logged.
Exact vendor model/library artifacts with SHA-256 and byte counts where distributable.
Picovoice terms/license/redistribution review for intended integration and distribution.
Rights-cleared, label-complete held-out cohort with frozen outputs and stratified analysis scoring.

caller_asset_contract.notes: Runtime/library/model/config/rights/terms files must exist at absolute paths with matching SHA-256 before any future processing. Access keys must be supplied only through approved runtime mechanisms and never recorded in manifests, reports, logs, or git.

exact_blockers.requirement: Provide an approved Picovoice Cobra runtime/library with exact version, platform, SHA-256, and license/terms review; no runtime is present.
Provide approved access-key handling and vendor terms for intended integration; no key/terms approval is recorded and keys must never be committed.
Provide exact Cobra model/library artifacts or documented vendor-managed immutable identifiers with SHA-256 where distributable; none are pinned locally.
Clear code/runtime/model/data/output redistribution and usage rights before any integration or distribution.
Provide a rights-cleared, label-complete held-out cohort with frozen candidate outputs and stratified analysis scoring; no cohort is present.
Produce approved reference/parity outputs and analysis-profile quality evidence against the exact runtime; no local output exists.
Measure paced target-device timing/resources under an approved runtime; no timing evidence exists.
Complete opt-in external-adapter intake, descriptor/registry review, and independent public-surface/release decision before any exposure; this package makes no such change.

gates.requirement: An approved Picovoice Cobra runtime, access-key policy, and vendor terms are reviewed for the intended integration.
Exact runtime/model/library artifacts or vendor-managed immutable identifiers, SHA-256 where distributable, and rights/redistribution records are complete.
A rights-cleared, label-complete held-out cohort with frozen outputs is available for analysis-profile scoring.
Approved reference/parity outputs are captured from the exact runtime/configuration on frozen inputs.
Timestamped probabilities/events, onset/offset, stratified FP/FN, validity separation, and state/interval integrity are scored on the held-out cohort.
Paced target-device timing/resources and availability are measured independently of compute speed.
Explicit opt-in external-adapter intake, descriptor/registry review, and independent public-surface decision are complete.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence, and release/public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

qualification.reason: No approved Picovoice Cobra runtime, access-key/terms approval, rights-cleared cohort, parity, or paced timing evidence is present; no qualifying result exists.

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the analysis acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. Verify vendor terms and clean integration before any distribution; keep source-reported scores labeled.
stable_fields.deliverable: Document the vendor boundary. Prototype an isolated adapter only if an approved public or user-supplied runtime is available. Use the documented external benchmark as a reference and require an approved runtime before a local integration.
